fields.System.Title: OUT-301 — Create a wave manually
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want to group allocated orders into a wave, so that picking work is
released in planned batches rather than one order at a time.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given allocated orders, when I select them, then a wave is created in planned
  • status.
  • - Given an unallocated order, then it cannot be added to a wave.
  • - Given an order already in an open wave, then it cannot be added to a second — enforced
  • by a unique constraint.
  • - Given a planned wave, then orders can be added and removed until it is released.
  • - Given the wave, then it records who created it and its target cut-off time.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound |
| Tables | wave, order |
| Risks | An order landing in two waves and being double-picked ([doc 05 WF 5](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · concurrency |
